gaps.title: Machine-readable security labeling and releasability at the point of production (born-releasable C2/ISR objects: tracks, reports, video, AI detections)
gaps.problem: Tracks, reports, video and AI-derived products are created on U.S. Secret systems without interoperable, machine-enforceable classification/releasability tags (ACP-240/ZTDF/IC-TDF), so ABAC and cross-domain filters cannot decide automatically and staff regenerate, re-key or hand-carry products to partner enclaves after weeks of phone-and-email negotiation.
gaps.user: Intelligence and fires staff producing REL products (35F/35G analysts, targeting officers), foreign disclosure officers, multinational intelligence cell analysts, CDS filter engineers, NGC2/data-layer integrators

gaps.title: Offline-capable zero-trust policy, key and replication enforcement for tagged data at the tactical edge (ZT Data Pillar under DDIL)
gaps.problem: Zero-trust access and TDF-style data protection stop working when the identity provider, policy decision point or key server is unreachable, and edge meshes that replicate through outages do not converge state while enforcing per-attribute classification, releasability and role rules, so units fall back to implicit trust or lose access to protected data.
gaps.user: Battalion/brigade S6 and data managers, NGC2 tactical cloud (hub/spoke) node operators, expeditionary targeting cells, coalition tactical MPE operators, ZT program offices
companies_near: Anduril (Lattice Mesh; ZT with Booz Allen)

gaps.title: DDIL geospatial data logistics: versioned delta-sync and prioritized distribution of basemaps, 3D terrain and overlays across TAK Server federations and NGC2 edge nodes
gaps.problem: Units still pre-load maps and 3D terrain by hand (USB/pre-mission loading) and lose overlay consistency across devices and servers when links drop, because no fielded service versions, prioritizes and delta-syncs geospatial data across TAK federations and NGC2 hub/spoke nodes.
gaps.user: Brigade/battalion geospatial engineers (12Y), TAK Server administrators, S6 sections, team leaders loading devices before missions; allied and DHS/CBP TAK users as unclassified first customers
companies_near: Booz Allen / PAR Government (Sit(x), TAK services)

gaps.title: Unified assured-PNT operational awareness and decision support (single pane for source health, composite confidence, jam/spoof triage, fallback recommendation) with a formation-level PNT interference picture feeding the C2/EW COP
gaps.problem: Navigation and EW operators must mentally fuse several fragmented displays of GPS/INS/alternate-source health to decide whether they are jammed, spoofed or broken and which fallback to take, with no composite confidence, no recommendation, no audit trail and no aggregation of local interference detections into a formation-level picture.
gaps.user: Navy ETV/ETSW and navigation teams on surface combatants (initial); EW/spectrum planners and battle captains at battalion through theater; JNWC and Space Force NAVWAR cells; Army MAPS/DAPS-equipped vehicle crews later
